message:
✨ added mobile haptic feedback and confetti effects

- Added haptic feedback using web-haptics for task interactions.
- Integrated confetti animation on task completion using canvas-confetti.
- Refactored Task component to improve tag management and UI interactions.
- Simplified TaskBar component by removing drag-and-drop functionality.
- Updated TaskList to use a more streamlined layout.
- Added new utility function for triggering confetti effects.
- Updated package dependencies to include canvas-confetti and web-haptics.
🚧 Refactoring & restructuring of cpn/ -> features/
🔧 Fix missing TooltipProvider in AppTopBar RightControls
🖌️ Tooltips on Tags popover icon buttons (delete, icon picker, add)
🔧 Tooltips on MainBar stop/finish + task ••• btn, fix time format (drop trailing 0s), remove dead parentPath code
🖌️ History filter: Select dropdowns for task+type, date range, tooltips on all icon buttons
🖌️ DeprecatedDataModal: download backup button, drop amber icon and em dash
✨ Remove SKILL.md documentation for shadcn component implementation
📖 Add emoji for AI-related changes in commit guide
📖 Fix local environment variable setup for NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
📖 Add CONTRIBUTING.md with commit emoji guide

🔧 Remove malikDebug / NEXT_PUBLIC_MALIK_DEBUG entirely

Dev toolbar already handles all debugging needs
🔧 Add banner image to public assets
🔧 README: drop badges, rewrite clean and minimal
🔧 Update README: banner.png header, tags in feature list, drop nesting

🔧 Add TagsButton, DeprecatedDataModal, wire into app

- TagsButton: popover with tag list (filter/delete), icon picker grid, create form
- DeprecatedDataModal: AlertDialog when legacy parentId data detected, reset or keep
- Wire both into AppTopBar TOP_CONTROLS and page.tsx

🔧 Replace task nesting with flat tasks + tags system

- New TagObj type with id/name/icon; TaskObj gets tagIds[], parentId removed
- Store: tags[], activeTagFilter, createTag/deleteTag/renameTag/assignTag/removeTag actions
- Legacy parentId detection in persist merge sets needsDataReset flag
- Date-grouped task list headers (Today, Yesterday, N days ago, Never started)
- TaskTagChips component on each task row: click to filter, right-click to remove
- Curated TAG_ICONS map (20 hugeicons) in cpns/tags/tag-icons.ts
- Flat drag-and-drop: before/after only, inside removed from utils and context
- Remove parentPath breadcrumb logic from useActiveTaskSummary
- Rewrite store-move tests for flat API
🔧 Hide finished tasks, date group headers, icon-only big stop/finish buttons
🔧 Update favicon.ico and add icon.png for PWA manifest
🔧 Strip canvas favicon, keep favicon.ico + tab title + PWA badge only

🔧 White squircle favicon, reorder mobile layout, bump breakpoint to lg

- ActiveTaskIndicator: always-on canvas favicon -- white rounded-square bg + dark icon (idle), red bg + white icon (active); no longer falls back to favicon.ico
- app/page.tsx: mobile layout order is now MainBar -> TaskBar -> TopControls -> AppCredits (timer first, controls last); bump md -> lg breakpoint so 768-1023px uses mobile layout instead of squished desktop
- AppTopBar: md:flex -> lg:flex to match

🔧 Dynamic red favicon, real icon for PWA manifest + README logo

- ActiveTaskIndicator: canvas-renders icon.png at 32x32 with source-atop red fill (#ef4444) when task active; falls back to green square SVG if image fails to load; idle state removes dynamic favicon so browser uses app/favicon.ico
- public/manifest.json: replace placeholder SVG with icon.png (144x144 RGBA)
- README: add centered icon.png logo above badges

🔧 Dev toolbar close btn, popover blur+rounded, mobile-responsive popovers

- DevToolbar: add X close button in panel header (Cancel01Icon)
- shadcn/ui/popover.tsx: bg-popover/95 + backdrop-blur-sm + shadow-xl + rounded-xl on all popovers
- shadcn/ui/popover.tsx: on mobile (<768px) grab the Radix popper wrapper via ref and override floating-ui inline styles to center-modal positioning (fixed, 50%/50%, translate -50/-50, max-h 85dvh)

🔧 Fix double DonStop in PWA title, update README

- ActiveTaskIndicator: detect standalone display-mode and drop ' · DonStop' suffix (PWA title bar already shows app name)
- README: rewrite casual/compact, update AI section (Claude not Copilot), add PWA install, auto-sort, dev toolbar, Ctrl+Enter, fix test count to 35

🔧 Dev toolbar, PWA manifest, badge API, clean up root screenshots

- cpns/dev/DevToolbar.tsx: dev-only floating panel (bottom-right tab) with store stats, populate fake data, add 3 quick tasks, show tour, copy store JSON, reset all data
- app/page.tsx: dynamic import DevToolbar, dev-only (dead-code-eliminated in prod)
- cpns/ActiveTaskIndicator.tsx: call navigator.setAppBadge(1)/clearAppBadge() when task active/idle (works when installed as PWA)
- public/manifest.json + public/icon.svg: PWA manifest enables browser install + badge API
- app/layout.tsx: wire manifest link + viewport themeColor
- .gitignore: add screenshot*.png rule
- .playwright-mcp → temp/playwright-mcp: --output-dir in .mcp.json (takes effect on next MCP restart)
- Delete 13 stale root screenshot debug files
🔧 Rename *.effects.ts to *.hooks.ts, live-task.ts to task.hooks.ts, delete dead files (RightClickMenu, Note, Separator, barrel SettingsButton)
🔧 Merge components/ into cpns/, remove settings.styles.ts, fix duration edit pre-fill, add filter empty state, add sortByPosition tests
🔧 Auto-sort tasks by last activated; parent bubbles up when subtask started
🔧 Fix selection leak on filter change; throttle task row timer to 60s
🔧 History filter by task/type; fix hover-only row buttons; running total in task row; remove right-click note
🔧 History config mode: cog toggle, selection/delete, per-row note+delete; fix note dialog close bug; empty task state hint
🔧 Add active task favicon/tab title indicator; update AppTopBar layout; add CLAUDE.md
🔧 Fix TrashButton: no popup when empty, only show confirm when tasks exist
🔧 Fix task UI: rounded-full icon buttons, bolder task label, fix 0s+ timer prefix, swap More icon
🔧 Ignore .mcp.json and .playwright-mcp in git
🔧 Add theme toggle (system/light/dark), white color option, timezone with UTC offset labels
🔧 Add notes to history activity items: right-click to add, badge shows count, popover lists notes with timestamps
🔧 Redesign history panel: grouped Today/Yesterday/This week/Older, total logs count, date-range clear popover
🔧 Add Stop/Finish buttons + Cmd/Ctrl+Enter shortcut to MainBar
🔧 ButtonGroup'd both privacy policy & terms n conditions button
🔧 Add title attribute to CreditLink for improved accessibility and clarity
🔧 Update cursor styles in HistoryMenu for consistency and improved UX
🔧 Implement custom cursor functionality; update TrashButton and HistoryMenu for improved accessibility; add arrow icon to SettingsButton; enhance CSS for custom cursor states.

🔧 Update contact emails in Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions; enhance button accessibility in TrashButton and HistoryMenu; add Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions links in AppTopBar; refactor SettingsButton for cleaner tooltip integration.
✨ Biome rewrite
🔧 Reorder Top Bar for consistency
🔧 Deployment TS error fix
🔧 Refactor conditional checks for touch support in Task component
✨ Better mobile accessibility
🖼️ Add Open Graph image
🔧 Update package.json to v1
🦠 Remove minimum tracked task duration logic from the store model
📝 Update README with recent features + AI section
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/1mlm/todo-app
🦠 Deleted demo video from repo
🦠 Change demo video source to GitHub assets link
🦠 Fixed demo video breaking README
✨ Added demo video
✨ Enhance calendar sync and task management features
✨ Added more history log types + refactoring
✨ Update app name to DonStop and enhance Google Calendar integration
✨ Fixed README GCalendar .env missing section
✨ First version complete
